description: Codex: Adeptus Custodes (11e) Emperor's Chosen — MAGNA IMPERATOR (WP-C46): when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit is selected to attack, it can re-roll one hit roll and one wound roll. Fixture cus11e_c3_custodes_active; setup: P1 detachment Emperor's Chosen, CP 0 for both, auto wound allocation. Fight phase: both Pile In halves passed, a real click selects the Blade Champion (engaged with the Deff Dread), attacks assigned and resolved: the engine re-rolls the first failed hit and the first failed wound once, named 'Magna Imperator' in the dice blocks' modifier ledger and the Dice Log.

steps.script:
GameState.state["factions"]["1"]["detachment"] = "Emperor's Chosen"
GameState.state.players["1"]["cp"] = 0
GameState.state.players["2"]["cp"] = 0
SettingsService.set("auto_allocate_wounds", true)
return true
